department: School of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences

deadline.value: The deadline for Fall 2027 is January 15, 2027.

gre_general.value: The school requires GRE General scores for admission; scoring above 55 percent in quantitative and verbal is said to help.

toefl_min.value: The school sets an Internet-based TOEFL minimum of 79 for non-native speakers.
toefl_min.quote: If English is not your native language, a minimum score of 79 (Internet-based) on the TOEFL or 550 (paper-based) is required.

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to contact potential faculty mentors before applying, especially for assistantships.
supervisor.quote: it's best to contact potential faculty mentors before you apply for admission

funding.value: The school offers a limited number of stipends, and most student support comes from individual faculty funds.
funding.quote: A limited number of stipends are available through SVMBS.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed before the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Program is run by the School of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, which sets its own GRE and TOEFL rules.
